PC: Demonstrate an appropriate initial approach to a critically ill newborn via primary survey (ABCDE)
Secure an airway via endotracheal intubation
Secure intraosseous access after failing intravenous access x 3
Appropriately manage seizure with antiepileptic drugs
Recognize and treat coagulopathy with vitamin K and FFP (fresh frozen plasma)
MK: Formulate a differential diagnosis, including sepsis, seizure or metabolic disorder, intracranial mass or bleed, inflicted or accidental trauma, acquired/congenital bleeding disorder including vitamin K deficiency
Recognize cerebral hemorrhage on head imaging (if available)
SBP: Activate the neonatal intensive care unit and neurosurgical teams for further management (if available)
ICS: Demonstrate effective team leadership, roles, and communication
